title: How to study a daily news headline
summary: Turn a short Norwegian headline into vocabulary, grammar and speaking practice without copying a whole article.

blocks.text: Turn a short Norwegian headline into vocabulary, grammar and speaking practice without copying a whole article.

items: Read the headline once without translation and predict the topic.
Identify the finite verb and sentence structure.
Extract 3–5 useful lemmas, not every unknown word.
Write one English translation, then one simpler Norwegian paraphrase.
Answer one speaking question using a B2 connector.
